## 12. Subsequent Events:

## Dividend

On February 26,2020, the Company's Board of Directors approved the payment of its quarterly dividend of $0.66 per common share. The dividend for the first quarter of 2020 will be paid to holders of record on March 13,2020. This estimated $30.1 million dividend payment is expected to be made on March 27,2020.
